content:
João Moutinho, Business & Internationalization Director, represented BUILT CoLAB in the panel of the BfK Jury – Born from Knowledge Ideas 2021, which took place on October 27th at Instituto Pedro Nunes, in Coimbra.

The business ideas in this contest were distributed by 4 thematic categories, having João Moutinho participated in the panel that evaluated the business ideas of the thematic category “Natural Resources, Environment, Energy and Sustainable Mobility”.

In total, this contest received 34 ideas, the largest number of ideas ever, divided into 4 categories: “Health and Wellness”, “Natural Resources, Environment, Energy and Sustainable Mobility”, “Tourism, Cultural and Creative Industries” and “Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Production Technologies”. Of the 34 competing projects, 10 finalist ideas were selected for the program’s final ceremony, which took place at the Convent of São Francisco, in Coimbra.

The winners were: . Natural Resources, Environment, Energy and Sustainable Mobility – Termy.co (Escola Superior Artística Do Porto) . Tourism, Cultural and Creative Industries – All.In (Estoril Higher School of Hospitality and Tourism (ESHTE)) . Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Production Technologies – Balvia (Polytechnic Institute of Bragança) . Health and Well-Being – Pick yoUR bRain (University of Coimbra)
